Where the agents actually run. Catalogued and linked, never operated by this system.
SAP, Ariba, SAP Datasphere, contract stores and spend systems are not integrated with this application. No
supplier record, contract, purchase order, invoice, price or spend figure is read, stored or transmitted by it
at any point. The marketplace describes agents; it does not operate them. This exclusion is what bounds the
data classification and the privacy assessment.
